title: Post-Exercise Glucose Recovery Curve
dataSources: Continuous glucose (`cgm:glucose`), HRV (`hrv:reading`), mood check-ins (`mood:checkin`), ketone readings (`ketone:reading`), reaction-time trials (`reaction:trial`), sauna sessions (`sauna:session`), resting temperature (`temp:reading`), and meditation logs (`meditation:session`).
app: Biohacking telemetry from CGMs, HRV devices, ketone meters, mood and meditation journals, reaction-time apps, sauna logs, and health sensors streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cgm:glucose
| stats avg(recovery_30m_delta) as avg_30m_delta avg(recovery_60m_delta) as avg_60m_delta by workout_type
| sort workout_type
description: Shows how glucose changes in the first 30 and 60 minutes after different types of workouts.
value: Exercise affects glucose differently depending on intensity and style, and this view makes recovery patterns easy to compare.
implementation: Tag workouts by type and attach post-exercise glucose deltas from your CGM or health export.
visualization: Grouped bar chart of 30-minute and 60-minute glucose recovery deltas by workout type.
grandmaExplanation: It spots how your glucose usually settles after different kinds of exercise.
